## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria met on **iOS and Android**
- [ ] Unit / component tests added or updated; coverage thresholds met
- [ ] E2E flow updated if a user journey changed
- [ ] Accessibility: labels, roles, dynamic type, contrast
- [ ] Strings externalised (`t('…')`)
- [ ] No personal data in logs; no secrets in code
- [ ] Authorisation enforced server-side for any new data access
- [ ] Docs updated (PRD / architecture / spec / ADR) where behaviour or design changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] New dependencies justified below (purpose, size, licence)
